rollback_evidence: Used only by the port-bounce operation (1.0.12 ios port maintenance, IOS-C021): 'shutdown', a pause, then 'no shutdown' on one Ethernet port as ONE operation behind the revert timer of Admin (configure terminal revert timer; an expired timer returns the whole running configuration to the archive, the port is enabled again). Measured on IOSvL2 15.2(20200924:215240): show running-config shows 'shutdown' only while the port is disabled; show interfaces N status of the check account reads the Status column (notconnect or connected before, disabled while shut, notconnect or connected after); show interfaces description reads 'admin down'. A port that is already shutdown is refused (port_disabled). The operation has no undo: it ends on the configuration before it and reports the link before and after. The time until a physical link is up again is not measured on the lab nodes (no peer on the test ports); Admin waits at most 20 s of reads of the check account and reports the observed state.
